title: Sharing my standalone "Caravan" card game project!
author: TheTaco2
selftext:
Hi all! I've been working on building a version of the minigame "Caravan" in my spare time. This uses the original rule set as well as a run mode with 5 opponents, a shop, and various equipment/card modifiers.

Theres a base deck + 4 unlockable sets of cards you can earn for completing achievements and runs. You can use unlocked cards to build custom decks to bring into future games.

I tried my best to make everything mobile and touch screen friendly. Theres controller support as well, thought that's still largely WIP. And of course, HUD and Radio options to really sell the post apocalyptic feeling 😄 

Assets and most code built with GPT-6-Astra, usually running on High with the $20 subscription plan. Occasional assists from Opus 5.5 for review / hosting / bug fixing in a separate worktree. 

Completely free and playable in browser! Give it a try and let me know what you think, thanks!  
[https://scrapjackgame.com/](https://scrapjackgame.com/)
